claim: Actual all-open trace/8 sheaf retractions for the five original completed quotient morphisms induce split injections and surjective normalized transfers on genuine derived sheaf H1, with codomain H1(E,f_*O_C); all-degree retractions and exact H0 comparison are included.

obligations.name: Actual sheaf carrier
obligations.required: Use the original additive structure sheaf and actual direct image, with a genuine sheaf condition.
obligations.constructed: sheaf X is X.presheaf followed by the actual forgetful functor CommRingCat to AddCommGrpCat. pushed f is the original direct-image presheaf followed by that functor.
obligations.justification: The original ring-sheaf condition is preserved by the limit-preserving forgetful functor; topological pushforward preserves sheaves. pushed_eq identifies the exact constructed sheaf with ordinary pushforward.

obligations.name: Actual structure map and variance
obligations.required: The map must be O_E to f_*O_C induced by the original completed curve morphism f:C to E.
obligations.justification: pullback_component states exact equality to f.app U for every actual target open and every section. No map in the Picard direction is substituted.

obligations.name: Unchanged all-open trace
obligations.required: Use the existing actual regular-function trace with its original coefficient action and exact degree.
obligations.constructed: characterTrace and fifthTrace wrap CompletedCharacterOpenTrace318.transfer and FifthOpenTrace318.transfer as genuine sheaf morphisms.
obligations.justification: Their original source and target presheaves are definitionally the newly sheaf-bundled original structure sheaves. The all-open trace_pullback statements give exactly8*s.

obligations.name: Normalization and restriction compatibility
obligations.required: Division by8 must use original target structural rational constants on every open and commute with restrictions.
obligations.constructed: scalar q U is the original Spec/global-sections comparison followed by q.appTop and restriction to U. retraction multiplies the actual trace by scalar q U(1/8).
obligations.justification: scalar_restrict proves the actual restriction square. eighth_mul follows by mapping the rational identity (1/8)*8=1. Naturality combines this exact square with the original trace naturality, without a new scalar action.

obligations.name: Coverage and all-five specialization
obligations.required: The sheaf identity must cover every open and every one of the five completed maps, including branch, infinity and empty opens.
obligations.constructed: The generic retraction theorem quantifies over all Y.Opens; the four complementary targets are universally indexed by Fin4 and the exact original fifth map is handled separately.
obligations.justification: No affine/nonempty hypothesis is introduced. character_split and fifth_split instantiate the original complete all-open degree identities. The maps use the publishedA/publishedB and original fifth A/B structures.

obligations.name: Genuine cohomology and existence
obligations.required: Use actual derived sheaf cohomology without assuming a desired dimension or defining it as a differential dual.
obligations.constructed: structureH and pushedH abbreviate Mathlib Sheaf.H of the exact additive sheaves; Sheaf.H is Ext from the constant integral sheaf.
obligations.justification: Pinned Grothendieck-abelian/HasExt instances supply the existing general cohomology construction on the small site of actual opens. No extra HasExt, Serre-duality, dimension or representability premise appears in the actual five-map theorems.

obligations.name: Functorial maps and degree-zero identity
obligations.required: The cohomology retraction must be induced by the actual sheaf maps with correct composition order; its normalization must agree with actual functions in degree0.
obligations.constructed: pullback and transfer are Sheaf.H.map of the actual structure map and normalized trace.
obligations.justification: H.map_comp_apply and H.map_id_apply transfer the exact sheaf equality to every degree. H.equiv0_naturality explicitly identifies the degree0 maps with the original pullback and actual transfer component.

obligations.name: Actual H1 consumers
obligations.required: Split injectivity and transfer surjectivity must hold on the actual five targets in degree1, not only on abstract retract data.
obligations.constructed: ActualQuotientHOne318 specializes all-degree equality to every original complementary map and the fifth, then gives explicit H1 injection/surjection endpoints.
obligations.justification: The general proof retains the actual maps. The composite normalized transfer after pullback is identity; LeftInverse.injective and RightInverse.surjective require exactly this equality. Projection idempotence uses the same maps.

obligations.name: Source-versus-pushforward comparison and scope
obligations.required: Do not identify Hn(E,f_*O_C) with Hn(C,O_C), or assert Serre duality/Jacobian consequences without the required actual comparison.
obligations.constructed: pushedH is explicitly cohomology on E with the direct-image coefficient sheaf. It is not defined to be cohomology on C.
obligations.justification: The packet proves split injections and surjections of abelian groups only. Direct-image cohomology comparison, one common-source fivefold H1 decomposition, H1 rational-module packaging, Picard-tangent/duality naturality, degree0 and representation remain separate. Existing differential equivalence is not conflated with tangent Picard pullback.
